name: PlayViewmodelFx
description: Plays an FX on the local client's viewmodel.

parameters.name: fxName
parameters.description: The FX name (i.e. `level._effect["path"]`) that should be played.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The viewmodel tag to play the FX on.

returns.name: fxId
returns.description: A handle to the playing effect that can be used to stop it later.

remarks: When playing effects from the viewmodel, you should check `Draw with View Model` in the FX editor settings. This ensures correct rendering.
Regardless of the above setting, FX models always render behind the viewmodel.
